claim_boundary: This is the declared finite ETA lookup-table domain.  Rows marked measured are already in the service-cache snapshot.  Rows marked pending_probe must be measured with task-native tqdm/progress before they can enter theorem-facing replay.  This design is exhaustive over the listed hardware, workload, load-state, profile, and migration factors; it is not a claim about arbitrary future workloads.
